text: I was hurt in a car accident in Brisbane. Which compensation lawyers should I contact?

result.keyword: I was hurt in a car accident in Brisbane. Which compensation lawyers should I contact?
result.markdown:
If you were injured in a car accident in Brisbane, you’ll generally want a **Queensland personal injury/CTP compensation lawyer** who regularly handles motor vehicle accident claims. A few Brisbane firms that handle these matters include:

- WT Law - Car Accident Lawyers Brisbane — focuses on car accident compensation claims in Brisbane and Queensland. [wtlaw.com.au](https://wtlaw.com.au/car-accident/compensation/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)  
- Splatt Lawyers — handles Queensland motor vehicle injury claims and advertises no-win/no-fee arrangements for eligible matters. [splattlawyers.com.au](https://splattlawyers.com.au/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)  
- Smith's Lawyers Brisbane — has a Queensland motor vehicle injury compensation practice. [www.smithslawyers.com.au](https://www.smithslawyers.com.au/compensation-law/motor-vehicle-injuries?utm_source=chatgpt.com)  
- Carter Capner Law — a Brisbane personal injury firm that handles compensation matters.   
- Best Injury Lawyers | Work & Road Accident Compensation Lawyers Brisbane — handles road accident compensation matters in Brisbane.   
- Queensland Compensation Lawyers — a Brisbane personal injury practice.   

Other established options include Shine Lawyers and Slater and Gordon, which both have Brisbane motor vehicle accident teams. [www.shine.com.au](https://www.shine.com.au/service/personal-injury-lawyers-qld/motor-vehicle-accidents?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

When you call, ask about:
- whether they handle **Queensland CTP claims**
- whether they offer a **free initial consultation**
- how their **no-win/no-fee** costs work (including any deductions from a settlement)
- whether they have experience with injuries similar to yours (e.g., fractures, spinal injuries, psychological injuries, loss of income)

Before choosing, it can help to speak with 2–3 firms and compare their advice and fee arrangements.

If you tell me:
1. whether you were the **driver, passenger, cyclist, or pedestrian**,  
2. whether the other driver was **at fault**, and  
3. roughly **when the accident happened**,  

I can help narrow down what type of lawyer you need and what claim pathway may apply in Queensland.
